jobs.prompt: Create an ORIGINAL transparent gameplay animation atlas. Reference 1 supplies the EXISTING GAME DRAGON identity, golden scales, orange/red mane, amber outlines and crisp detailed wuxia pixel-painted game rendering. Reference 2 supplies ONLY the CONCEPT of a dragon curling its long BODY into one circular coil; DO NOT copy its green colors, illustration style, clouds or scene. Use the reference1 GOLDEN dragon throughout. Fixed elevated orthographic three-quarter top-down RPG camera. EXACT 4 columns x3rows, twelve complete separated sprites, generous transparent gutters. A sequential animation: cells0-7 (rows1-2) show ONE dragon progressively CURLING ITS BODY INTO ONE CLOSED RING at a FIXED centre. Its head travels clockwise around its OWN bending serpentine body as the tail follows: 0 open C shape, 1 larger C, 2 three-quarter loop, 3 nearly closed loop with head low-left, 4 full loop with head upper-left and tail lagging, 5 tight circular coil head high, 6 coil tighter head high-right, 7 head lifts near front-centre while tail finishes ONE wrap. The anatomy must visibly deform, bend and overlap; NOT eight rotations of one rigid image, NOT eight copies of a side-view dragon. Distinct neck/body/tail shapes, flowing mane and moving claws in every cel. Row3 cell8 starts UNCOILING UPWARD, head/horns pointing skyward and body vertical; cell9 extends up with back of head visible and tail hanging; cell10 curls head DOWN into a steep nosedive, tail above; cell11 fully DIVES HEAD-FIRST DOWNWARD toward ground, face/snouth pointing lower centre and full tail trailing high. Entire same dragon in every cel, uniform physical size, fixed camera, no image-plane rotation. No humans, terrain, ground shadows, text, borders, UI, circles of light or cloudy background. True alpha-zero background, crisp continuous amber edge, sparse tight glow only. Fit every whole dragon safely inside its own cell, at least12percent transparent margin each side. This sheet is actual frame artwork, not a concept composition.

Create an ORIGINAL transparent game VFX atlas for a clearly readable HEAVY DOWNWARD STAFF SWING. Reference1 is existing game gold/amber wuxia VFX palette; make this stronger, crisper and more readable. Reference2 supplies ONLY the idea of an OVERHEAD TO GROUND staff swing trail, NOT its anime style, character, sky, terrain or debris. Draw ONLY luminous curved swing trails, no character, no staff object, no ground cracks or dust. Fixed elevated orthographic three-quarter top-down RPG camera. EXACT4columns x3rows, twelve fully isolated complete VFX cels with large alpha-zero gutters. Columns are four chronological frames: 0 compact bright overhead anticipation streak; 1 expanding overhead-to-forward curved trail; 2 full powerful downward C/HOOK arc with thick ivory-white core, gold edge, two thinner parallel speed cuts, narrowing sharply to ONE clear contact endpoint near ground; 3 residual taper after impact. Rows are genuine authored camera views: row1 swing toward screen RIGHT, arc starts upper-left/over caster head and curves across upper area DOWN toward a clear LOWER-RIGHT contact tip; row2 swing toward screen DOWN, narrow symmetrical foreshortened front view, overhead top-centre trail descends toward LOWER-CENTRE contact endpoint; row3 swing toward screen UP away from camera, narrow rear view, trail starts lower-centre over shoulders and swings toward UPPER-CENTRE contact endpoint. All four columns in a row share the SAME contact endpoint when fitted to their equal-size virtual cell, same base circle centre and physical radius. Trail is grounded in a vertical swing plane, NOT a horizontal circular spin, not a slash projected far from the caster. Complete effect in each cell, at least12percent empty transparent margin; no overlap. Clear main stroke at normal gameplay size, controlled tight gold glow, no broad blurry haze, no hands, people, weapons, terrain, labels, panel lines or text. Keep authentic crisp gold detailed wuxia GAME SPRITE treatment of reference1, not a comic illustration.
